BEN.note: No AI rule or draft stated.
No national cyber body, strategy, response or critical infrastructure designation stated.
Decrees on interception, data access and cryptology are named but the document does not say they make attacks on systems a crime or set cybersecurity duties; nothing on use of a law.
No data protection provisions or decree stated among the eight decrees.
Nothing on data protection law, authority or practice.

facts.fact: Benin's Council of Ministers adopted on 2025-07-02 eight implementing decrees of the Code du numerique, including decrees on conditions for electronic archiving service providers and on technical specifications and assurance levels for electronic identification schemes.

BEN.note: The document does not itself say the Code covers electronic transactions or online selling.
No international standards membership, adoption or requirement stated.
No national standards body or IT standard stated; the e-ID decree sets specifications for identification schemes, not a national standard.
